data.text:
BAYAN: POLICE BLOCKED PREPARATIONS FOR LUNETA RALLY

READ: Progressive coalition Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (BAYAN) says the police blocked the preparations for the anti-corruption protest to be conducted at the Luneta Park in Manila on Sunday, Nov. 30.

BAYAN, among the organizers of the rally, says they were not given with a permit, the same situation during their Sept. 21 rally, but the protest was coordinated with the Manila government and the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority. It cites the announcement of road closures and the setting up of MMDA portalets in the area as signs of the coordination with authorities.

Still, BAYAN and their allied groups say they will continue to gather at the Luneta for their Nov. 30 rally.

📸 BAYAN/Facebook

data.text:
'LGU MANILA INTERPOSES NO OBJECTION TO THE PROTEST'

Tiniyak ni Manila Mayor Isko Moreno na magbibigay pa rin ang Manila City local government unit (LGU) ng mga ng tulong gaya ng traffic, garbage at emergency medical assistance kasunod ng mga isasagawang kilos-protesta gaya ng Trillion Peso March sa Maynila ngayong Linggo. Nov. 30.

Pero paglilinaw ng alkalde, sakop ng MMDA ang Roxas Boulevard habang Luneta naman sa National Parks Development Committee (NPDC) kaya mas mabuting sa kanila makipag-ugnayan kaugnay ng mga isasagawang rally rito.

Hindi naman na kailangan ng rally permit mula sa alinmang local o national agency para sa mga kilos-protesta sa Liwasang Bonifacio at Freedom Park.
